pages.title: Cannon Smash Fest
pages.creator: Kankane Games
pages.description: Aim a cannon at breakable structures in Cannon Smash Fest. Adjust the shot's angle and power, then see whether the first hit starts a chain reaction that clears the setup.

pages.title: Sara's Cooking Class: Spooky Food
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Follow Sara's recipe in Sara's Cooking Class: Spooky Food. Use the mouse to prepare the ingredients and work through the steps for a Halloween-themed dish.

pages.title: Desert Rover Survival
pages.creator: Raccoon
pages.description: Build a vehicle for the wasteland in Desert Rover Survival. Start with a basic rover and improve parts and technology so you can travel farther into the desert.

pages.title: Screw Color Sorting Master
pages.creator: SecGame
pages.description: Sort screws onto matching poles in Screw Color Sorting Master. Keep a spare position available while moving pieces around, then finish each stack with screws of the same color.

pages.title: Block Builder Jam
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Drop blocks into the outline in Block Builder Jam. Account for how gravity makes each piece fall and settle, then use the remaining space to finish the shape.

pages.title: Ellie And Friends Art Bloom Aesthetic
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Make art-inspired outfits in Ellie And Friends Art Bloom Aesthetic. Pick colorful clothes and accessories for the friends and try combinations that give each one a different look.

pages.title: Feed me Monsters! Idle Battle
pages.creator: TuuT
pages.description: Battle beasts and other creatures in Feed me Monsters! Idle Battle. Watch how your fighter fares against the current enemy and build up strength for the fights that follow.

pages.title: Quiz Squid Round
pages.creator: Newness Games
pages.description: Test how well you remember the series in Quiz Squid Round. Read the prompts carefully and choose the answers that fit the show's characters, events, and details.

pages.title: Magic Finger
pages.creator: TapNation
pages.description: Throw aliens with your powers in Magic Finger. Send enemies into one another or over the edge, and use explosive barrels when you can catch a group in the blast.

pages.title: Chill Girl Clicker
pages.creator: GM - Good Media
pages.description: Tap to build up your score in Chill Girl Clicker. Keep clicking and put what you earn back into the game to see how your progress changes over time.

pages.title: Space Blast
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Pilot a ship through waves of meteors in Space Blast. Use its weapons to clear a path and steer out of the way of rocks that get past your fire.

pages.title: The Basement isn't THAT haunted
pages.creator: Studio Schneeya
pages.description: Search basement boxes with a little bunny in The Basement isn't THAT haunted. Work out where the things you want are hiding and avoid opening boxes that contain ghosts.

pages.title: Save The Beauty
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Help the character get past traps in Save The Beauty. Look over each two-dimensional layout and judge how to move through it as the obstacles change from level to level.

pages.title: Hex Triple Match
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Group matching hexagonal tiles in Hex Triple Match. Think through each placement and how it will affect neighboring pieces before putting down another group.

pages.title: Granny 2 asylum horror house
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Search an abandoned asylum in Granny 2 asylum horror house. Collect items to help you escape and use the weapons you find when you need to defend yourself.

pages.title: InsectaQuest-Adventures
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Look for insects and hidden objects in InsectaQuest-Adventures. Use the wheel to earn coins and unlock the Magic Magnifying Glass to reveal details you might otherwise miss.

pages.title: Tornado Giant Rush
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Steer a tornado toward matching colors in Tornado Giant Rush. Collect pieces of its own color to grow and avoid other colors while you head for the finish.

pages.title: Cat Runner
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Run through different worlds with Tom in Cat Runner. Slide and dodge past hazards on the way to the treasure, then try other characters and outfits as they unlock.

pages.title: Shoot Em All
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Plan shots in Shoot Em All using the visible bullet paths. Check where a shot will travel before firing and make sure your blue character survives the exchange.

pages.title: Happy Farm Tiles Match
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Connect identical farm pictures in Happy Farm Tiles Match. Look for a clear route between each pair and try to clear all the tiles before time runs out.

pages.title: Survive The Glass Bridge
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Choose between glass panels in Survive The Glass Bridge. Work across one pair at a time and avoid stepping onto the thinner panes that won't hold you.

pages.title: Route to the beach
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Draw a path for a boat in Route to the beach. Look for the dangers between the boat and shore and bend your route around them before sending it across.

pages.title: Snake and Ladder Board Game
pages.creator: Pro_Gaming
pages.description: Roll the dice in Snake and Ladder Board Game. Move along the board and see whether a ladder takes you forward or a snake sends you back. Unlock six boards in order.

pages.title: Perfect Tongue
pages.creator: PL Studio
pages.description: Pick up food with a long tongue in Perfect Tongue. Time when to extend it and pull it back so you can eat what's safe without touching dangerous objects.

pages.title: Dot Dot
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Pair red and yellow dots by color in Dot Dot. Watch what's falling from above and switch at the right time, since a mismatched pair ends the round.

pages.title: Blue and Red İmpostor
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Escape rising water with two players in Blue and Red İmpostor. Move one character with WASD and the other with the arrows, and get both through each part in time.

pages.title: Love Tester Julie
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Enter two names in Love Tester Julie to get a playful compatibility result. Try a different pair to see what the game's name-based calculation comes up with.

pages.title: Happy Filled Glass
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Draw a route to fill the glass in Happy Filled Glass. Use a mouse or touchscreen to sketch a line that guides the water into the container.

pages.title: Fury Bike Rider
pages.description: Race motorcycles or take them out for a drive in Fury Bike Rider. Choose modes such as races against computer riders, and use the game's upgrade system to improve your bike.

pages.title: Sky Bike Stunt 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Ride a motorcycle through stunt courses in Sky Bike Stunt 3D. Watch each approach and use the bike's momentum to clear the obstacles as the route changes.

pages.title: Love Pin 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Pull pins in the right order in Love Pin 3D. Work out what each one is keeping in place and open a path to the bride while avoiding the villains.

pages.title: Shoot The Watermelon
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Line up watermelons and fire in Shoot The Watermelon. Watch how each target is positioned and adjust your aim before pulling the trigger in the shooting exercises.

pages.title: Mysterious Balls
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Tap to change the balls in the bowl in Mysterious Balls. Match the color of the incoming ball before it arrives so you can keep the round going.

pages.title: Lion Hunting 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Track the requested animal in Lion Hunting 3D. Look through the jungle carefully and pick out the target the mission specifies before taking your shot.

pages.title: My Cute Pet Friend
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Look after a pet in My Cute Pet Friend. Keep it healthy, try outfits and activities, and take it along when you explore more of the game's world.

pages.title: Crazy Bicycle
pages.creator: comeplay
pages.description: Take a bicycle through stunt challenges in Crazy Bicycle. Judge how you approach the obstacles and keep the bike under control as you try the different routes.

pages.title: Pixel Jumper
pages.creator: YAKPI
pages.description: Time your jumps in Pixel Jumper and move past the traps in the pixel-art course. Keep an eye on the next landing as you work your way forward.

pages.title: Fighter Plane Jet Fighting Game 2D
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Pilot an F-22 in Fighter Plane Jet Fighting Game 2D. Use the arrows to steer and space to fire, and look for seeker missiles hidden around the level.

pages.title: Buddy Hill Race
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Drive over rolling terrain in Buddy Hill Race. Collect at least ten coins when you can so you can buy more fuel and keep the run going.

pages.title: Whack a Zombie
pages.creator: SUCCESS Corporation
pages.description: Hit zombies as they come out of the ground in Whack a Zombie. React quickly and see whether you can strike faster than the computer opponent.

pages.title: Army Of Skeletons Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Rebuild skeleton scenes in Army Of Skeletons Jigsaw. Choose from twelve pictures and solve them with 25, 49, or 100 pieces, using nearby details as clues.

pages.title: Girls and Cars Puzzle 2
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Fit together the six illustrations in Girls and Cars Puzzle 2. Pick a picture and a piece count, then use matching edges and colors to complete it.

pages.title: Firearm Simulator
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Practice shooting at a virtual range in Firearm Simulator. Choose one of four weapons and try different modifications to see how they feel in the range exercises.

pages.title: My Teacher Classroom Fun
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Take on activities around a school in My Teacher Classroom Fun. Move between jobs such as caring for a pet and solving puzzles as you explore what the classroom has to offer.

pages.title: Monster Track 2
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Drive bulky vehicles through hilly tracks in Monster Track 2. Balance the car on rises and drops and try the additional vehicles as you work through the sixty courses.

pages.title: Emoji Pong
pages.creator: Jam Game Studio
pages.description: Keep the ball off the floor in Emoji Pong while bouncing it into emojis. Adjust to the faster pace and stay under the ball to build your score.

pages.title: Down The Mountain
pages.creator: Umbrella Games
pages.description: Descend a mountain in Down The Mountain. Choose where to step to avoid hazards and enemies, and collect stars and useful power-ups on the way down.

pages.title: Basket Swooshes Plus
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Aim for eleven points in Basket Swooshes Plus. Try the World Cup or Time Challenge, or play the two-player mode with a friend on a separate device.

pages.title: Breakout Game
pages.creator: Digi Smile limited
pages.description: Bounce the ball into every brick in Breakout Game. Keep it from falling as the levels add more bricks, and watch the three lives you start with.

pages.title: Endless Shaft
pages.creator: The Voices Games
pages.description: Guide a falling character down five different shafts in Endless Shaft. Steer away from bats, rocks, or missiles as you see how far you can descend in each one.

pages.title: Purse Cards Match
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Flip cards and match the handbags in Purse Cards Match. Remember which purse you saw in each spot and clear the layout by finding all the identical pairs.

pages.title: Magikmon
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Capture magical creatures in Magikmon as a new student at a wizarding school. Train your team to handle wild opponents and work your way through the entrance test.

pages.title: Police Cop Car Simulator City Missions
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Take a patrol car out on assignments in Police Cop Car Simulator City Missions. Follow the city routes and pursue suspects as part of your police duties.

pages.title: 5Dice Duel
pages.creator: Zigiz
pages.description: Roll five dice and choose scoring combinations in 5Dice Duel. Look for a full house, large straight, or another useful category before deciding where to record the roll.

pages.title: Tractor Puzzle Farming
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Drive over every plot in Tractor Puzzle Farming without crossing any of them twice. Plan where to turn with the mouse or arrows so you don't leave a patch behind.

pages.title: Cartoon Trucks Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Slide tiles to reconstruct cartoon trucks in Cartoon Trucks Slide. Pick one of three pictures and a mode, then match the outlines as you rearrange the board.

pages.title: Tasty Donut Match3
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Match at least three doughnuts in Tasty Donut Match3. Build your score with each group, and keep the matches coming before the meter on the left falls too low.

pages.title: Superbike Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Restore a superbike picture in Superbike Slide. Choose from three images and three layouts, and use the wheels or bodywork as clues as you slide tiles into place.

pages.title: Ford Capri Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble a picture of the Ford Capri in Ford Capri Puzzle. Pick from six images and four piece counts, then follow the body lines and background to find matching pieces.

pages.title: Picture Puzzle
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Drag jigsaw pieces into place in Picture Puzzle. Use the mouse to rebuild each illustration within sixty seconds and move on to the next painting.

pages.title: Formula Jigsaw
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Build racing-car jigsaws in Formula Jigsaw. Drag the pieces into place and choose a difficulty for each picture. Unlock more images with the game's currency.

pages.title: EG Super PonGoal
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Keep the ball in play in EG Super PonGoal. Pick a ball and adjust the difficulty from the menu, then use the paddle to return shots.

pages.title: Tractor Farming Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Use WASD to drive a tractor in Tractor Farming Simulator and space for the handbrake. Work through the levels and try different tractor skins as you go.

pages.title: BTS Sweet Bear Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Paint bear drawings in BTS Sweet Bear Coloring. Pick a color with the brush and fill the sections, then try another combination for the animals and their surroundings.

pages.title: Zombie Factory Tycoon
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Build up an undead workforce in Zombie Factory Tycoon. Click zombie icons to spawn them, let them attack the people on the map, and spend the money they earn to unlock more zombies.

pages.title: Planets Jigsaw Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Put together pictures of planets in Planets Jigsaw Challenge. Pick a difficulty and use colors, curves, and details in the planet pictures to fit the pieces together.

pages.title: Vintage Cars Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild six vintage car images in Vintage Cars Puzzle. Choose a piece count from sixteen to a hundred and match details in the vehicles and scenery.

pages.title: Monster Typer
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Type words as they appear in Monster Typer to fight monsters. Keep an eye on the spelling and enter each word quickly so you can deal with the next creature.

pages.title: Domestic Animals Memory
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Match animal cards before the timer ends in Domestic Animals Memory. Remember the positions from earlier turns and clear all the pairs across four increasingly difficult levels.

pages.title: Residence Of Evil
pages.creator: danygames.com
pages.description: Fight through zombie encounters in Residence Of Evil. Explore the stages from a first-person view, use the weapons you find, and adjust as different types of undead appear.

pages.title: Dog Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose how to make a dog picture in Dog Puzzle. Fit together pieces in the jigsaw or connect the dots to reveal a dog drawing.

pages.title: Dragon City
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Control a dragon over a populated city in Dragon City. Use fireballs, flame breath, or a melee sweep, and try different skins for the creature.

pages.title: Princesses on Ibiza
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Plan vacation outfits in Princesses on Ibiza. Pick summer clothes for the princesses to wear after trading winter weather for sunshine on the island.

pages.title: Chef Mix
pages.creator: Bofer Media (Twim Studio)
pages.description: Prepare ingredients and cook in Chef Mix. Work out how to combine them to recreate familiar sandwiches and compare what you made with the recipes you're aiming for.

pages.title: Super Hero Space Dress Up
pages.creator: Papi Game
pages.description: Style a superhero for a mission in Super Hero Space Dress Up. Browse the outfit options and put together a look for the character chosen to save space.

pages.title: Color Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Pick the tile that differs from the rest in Color Challenge. Compare the shades closely and find the odd color to move on to the next level.

pages.title: Fidget Spinner Extreme
pages.creator: Pupgam Studios
pages.description: Spin a fidget toy in Fidget Spinner Extreme and watch its speedometer. Try to get the numbers as high as possible and compare your fastest attempts.

pages.title: Princess Highschool Trends
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Choose outfits for school fashion icons in Princess Highschool Trends. Browse their wardrobes and build a look for each character before they head to class.

pages.title: Cricket Batter Challenge Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Take on six teams in Cricket Batter Challenge Game. Watch the marker on the ground and press the appropriate arrow when it turns green to time your shot.

pages.title: Editors Pick Mermaid
pages.creator: GAMEGOS
pages.description: Create a mermaid look for a movie in Editors Pick Mermaid. Style the fashion editor for her new role before she heads to the first day of filming.

pages.title: Kylie's Favourite Car
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Prepare a car show in Kylie's Favourite Car. Help Kylie choose how she'll look as the presenter and decorate the stage for the vehicle she's introducing.

pages.title: Crazy Mommy Busy Day
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Help a busy parent through her tasks in Crazy Mommy Busy Day. Follow what she needs to do next and work through the household responsibilities shown by the game.

pages.title: Little Princess Hair Treatment
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Find the tools for Sofia in Little Princess Hair Treatment. Search for the hidden items first, then use them to help the princess with her hair.

pages.title: Fashion Princess
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Put together an outfit for a date in Fashion Princess. Try different combinations from the closet and choose the pieces that give the princess the look you want.
